Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the thorough walkthrough of FinPay's use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment:

Summary from call:
- Primary use case: real-time risk scoring + customer support snippets (short-form generation)
- Expected q3 traffic: ~50k requests/day with 300–600 token avg responses
- Decision criteria: latency under 300ms p95, reproducible outputs, and clear cost per 1k tokens for forecasting
- Key internal stakeholders you mentioned: Sonia (Product), Rajiv (Procurement), and Legal (contracts)

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones:
1) Security & compliance review (Redwood to share SOC2 summary + answers) — target: 2 weeks
2) Procurement & pricing review (FinPay to share procurement timeline and PO) — target: 1–2 weeks after security signoff
3) Pilot on Dedicated capacity (2-week performance validation) — target: dev/test in 3–4 weeks
4) Executive signoff and rollout plan (commercial terms + SLA) — target: end of Q3

I attached an editable MAP (FinPay_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v0.2.xlsx) with the milestones above. Can you confirm:
- Who owns procurement (name + email)?
- Target date for contract review (legal/procurement availability)?
- Any additional compliance evidence you need beyond our SOC2/pen test summary?

Next steps from Redwood:
- Camila will draft the MAP and populate proposed dates (attached MAP-template.xlsx).
- Dev will prepare a short config/throughput note outlining Dedicated pool sizing.
- I will gather SOC2 summary and a short performance FAQ for your security team.

If that looks right, I'll share an updated MAP by tomorrow EOD. Happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up if useful.

Best,
